name: Patron: The Drowned Widow of Coldmere Bay (Sea Hag) (Witch)

system.description:
Fishermen along the Jinia coast leave offerings at low tide so she doesn't come looking herself. She was beautiful once, or so the stories insist, right before the sea decided otherwise.

  • Recipe (1st): Murk Brew.
  • Patron Curse (3rd): Once per day, force a creature within 30ft to make a Will save or be wracked by the Drowned Widow's Gaze: its speed is halved and it can't speak (no verbal spells) for the encounter, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.
  • Physical Change (7th): Your skin turns faintly grey and clammy, and thin gill-like slits appear at your throat.
  • You can breathe underwater and gain a swim speed of 20ft.
  • Once per day, as your action, a creature within 30ft makes a Fortitude save or its lungs seize with phantom water: it falls Prone and loses its next action.
